spans.s: एष r. 1st. cl. (ऋ) एषृ (एषते) To go or approach.

एषा f. (-षा) Desire.
 E. इष् to wish, अङ् and टाप् aff.

एषण m. (-णः) An iron arrow.
 f. (-णी)
 1. A goldsmith's balance, assay
scales.
 2. An iron or steel probe.
 E. एष् to go, ल्युट् and ङीष् aff.

एषणिका f. (-का) A goldsmith's balance. E. As before, with कन् and टाप्
added.

एषणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
 1. To be desired, desirable.
 2. To be aimed at.
E. इष् to wish, affix अनीयर्.
